labels.shortDescription: Setup check screen title
labels.value: Setup check

labels.shortDescription: Setup check screen intro
labels.value: These checks show whether the Unsubscribe Link is ready to use.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check site pass
labels.value: Pass: The Experience site exists and is active.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check site fail
labels.value: Fail: The Experience site is missing or not active.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check site fix hint
labels.value: In Setup, go to Digital Experiences, All Sites. If there is no Unsubscribe site, create it as the Set Up Instructions describe. If its status is not Active, open Workspaces, Administration, Settings and click Activate. Then publish the site in Experience Builder.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check org-wide email pass
labels.value: Pass: The org-wide email address for confirmation emails is verified.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check org-wide email fail
labels.value: Fail: The org-wide email address for confirmation emails is missing or not verified.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check org-wide email fix hint
labels.value: In Setup, go to Organization-Wide Addresses. Add the address if it is missing. If it is not verified, click the link in the email Salesforce sent to that address, or send it again from that page. Confirmation emails do not go out until the address is verified.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check Public Id pass
labels.value: Pass: Every Contact and Lead with an email address has a Public Id.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check Public Id fail
labels.value: Fail: Some Contacts or Leads with an email address have no Public Id.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check count of Contacts without Public Id
labels.value: Contacts without a Public Id

labels.shortDescription: Setup check count of Leads without Public Id
labels.value: Leads without a Public Id

labels.shortDescription: Setup check Public Id fix hint
labels.value: This setup just started the job that adds the missing Public Ids, so this check fails the first time. You get an email when the job is done. Run this setup again after that to check.

labels.shortDescription: Warning shown when the Admin turns on type-in mode
labels.value: Warning: With this on, anyone, including a script, can type in any list of email addresses and unsubscribe them. Nothing checks that the person typing owns the address.

labels.shortDescription: Subject of the Confirmation Email
labels.value: Unsubscribe Confirmation

labels.shortDescription: Subject of the Unsubscribe Request digest
labels.value: Unsubscribe Link: Unsubscribe Requests need your attention

labels.shortDescription: First line of the Unsubscribe Request digest
labels.value: The Unsubscribe Link batch processed Unsubscribe Requests. Some of them need your attention.

labels.shortDescription: Digest line, {0} is a number
labels.value: Unsubscribed: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Digest line, {0} is a number
labels.value: Error, tried again in the next run: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Digest line, {0} is a number
labels.value: Error, no retries left: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Digest line, {0} is a number
labels.value: Not Found, no Contact or Lead matches: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Digest line, {0} is a number
labels.value: Confirmation emails that could not be sent: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Last part of the Unsubscribe Request digest
labels.value: Open the Needs attention list view on the Unsubscribe tab to see these Unsubscribe Requests. Requests with no retries left and Not Found Requests are not processed again, so set Email Opt Out by hand where needed.

labels.shortDescription: Label of the email field on the type-in screen
labels.value: Email address

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow section title for request processing
labels.value: Processing Unsubscribe Requests

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow intro for request processing
labels.value: The unsubscribe page only records an Unsubscribe Request. A scheduled job then opts out the matching Contacts and Leads and sends the confirmation email. The job runs as you, the user running this setup. If your user is deactivated, the job stops, so run this setup again as another Admin before that happens.

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow field label for the batch interval
labels.value: How often should Unsubscribe Requests be processed? (hours)

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow field label for retention days
labels.value: After how many days should Not Found Unsubscribe Requests be deleted?

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow field label for max retry attempts
labels.value: How many times should a failed Unsubscribe Request be tried?

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow error when a number is below 1
labels.value: Enter 1 or more.

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow checkbox label for legacy links
labels.value: Accept links from the old unmanaged Unsubscribe Link app

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow text explaining the legacy link setting
labels.value: Leave this off unless you sent emails with the old unmanaged Unsubscribe Link app. Those links contain the Contact or Lead record Id instead of a Public Id. Record Ids are much easier to guess than Public Ids, so with this on, someone could unsubscribe other people by trying record Ids.

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow title when scheduling fails
labels.value: The Unsubscribe Request job could not be scheduled.

labels.shortDescription: Setup flow hint when scheduling fails
labels.value: Unsubscribe Requests stay Pending until the job runs. Fix the error below and run this setup again.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check scheduled job pass
labels.value: Pass: The Unsubscribe Request job is scheduled and runs as an active user.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check scheduled job fail
labels.value: Fail: The Unsubscribe Request job is missing, has an error, or runs as an inactive user.

labels.shortDescription: Setup check scheduled job fix hint
labels.value: Run this setup again as an active Admin. That schedules the job again under your user. You can see the job in Setup under Scheduled Jobs.
